flags.why: “Ông ấy mất đã xanh cỏ rồi” awkwardly combines “mất” with a phrase that already means being long dead.
flags.fix: Ông ấy đã xanh cỏ từ lâu rồi. = He has been dead and buried for ages.

flags.why: The use of Honda as a generic name for motorbikes is mainly Southern ([regional vocabulary source](https://www.vietchigo.art/index.php/vn/137-suu-tam/3158-cac-tu-mien-nam)).
“Sau năm phút” means after five minutes, whereas “within five minutes” allows an earlier arrival.
flags.fix: The ambulance arrived at the house after five minutes.

flags.why: “Xe dù” is also routinely used in Southern Vietnamese, so the Northern label is misleading ([Southern usage](https://www.sggp.org.vn/nhan-dien-xe-du-post107856.html)).
“Xe lôi” denotes a cart or passenger carriage pulled by a bicycle or motorbike, rather than a buggy ([vehicle description](https://proship.vn/news/tim-hieu-xe-loi-la-xe-gi/)).
flags.fix: cart or passenger carriage pulled by a bicycle or motorbike

flags.why: “Xe than” refers to a vehicle converted to run on charcoal-generated gas, rather than specifically a coal-burning minibus ([historical account](https://phudoanlagi.blogspot.com/2020/06/hoc-tro-truong-huyen-i-thi-ai-hoc.html?m=0)).
flags.fix: charcoal-powered vehicle (converted to run on gas generated from charcoal)
